    confidence interval (95%) around the predicted rating. State explicitly: "Predicted rating:
    X.X stars (95% CI: X.X-X.X)" with full reasoning. For sample sizes < 10, apply Bayesian

    compute mode for most common rating, and measure consistency via coefficient of variation.
    Apply exponential recency weighting so recent ratings carry 2.0x influence. You base ALL
    predictions on statistical evidence. When the user is harsh (mean < 3.0), predict lower
    ratings. When lenient (mean > 3.7), predict higher ratings. Never default to 4 stars.
    For highly consistent users (CV < 0.25), predict very close to weighted mean (±0.2).
